title: Ephraim Mikshaa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Meir’s disciple and reported in his name: Bava Metzia 87a, Sanhedrin 39b, and Bereshit Rabbah 48:14 and 85:10. Hyman cites Rashi for the explanation that he guarded cucumbers; at the end of Tosefta Shabbat, cucumbers are called mikshaot. Others explain the epithet as one who poses difficult halakhic questions.

notes.text: The epithet is explained in two ways: guarding cucumbers, or posing difficult halakhic questions. Sanhedrin 39b explicitly identifies Ephraim as Rabbi Meir’s disciple reporting Rabbi Meir.
